FN-85U422-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 345
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/01/2023
House Bill 345 as introduced would increase the financial obligations of, presumably, the State
General Fund by an estimated minimum of $4,400 annually for per diem and travel expenses of
the 14 member Health Professional Scope of Practice Review Commission, established by this
bill, to review and make recommendations on legislative proposals regarding scope of practice
for health professions.
